name: Argentine Peso
oneLiner: WARS is Ripio's wrapped Argentine peso stablecoin targeting 1 WARS = 1 ARS, backed by ARS bank deposits and local-currency instruments via wFIAT.
collateral: Argentine peso reserves and local-currency liquid instruments backing WARS at a 1:1 target against the Argentine peso
pegMechanism: Issuer-managed fiat-backed stablecoin route targeting 1 WARS = 1 ARS; DefiLlama classifies the asset as fiat-backed

mintAuthority.summary: WARS is an issuer-managed Ripio wFIAT token. Ethereum role logs resolve two current DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holders plus three current MINTER_ROLE holders; non-Ethereum deployments remain unverified.

review.evidence: Review is scoped to Ethereum role-holder coverage: Ripio identifies WARS as a wrapped local stablecoin, and the lane-2 role reconstruction resolves two current Ethereum DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holders and three current MINTER_ROLE holders.

Ethereum implementation source for 0xba0030...21b9 remains unresolved.
Policy/custody layer for the current Ethereum role holders and any per-chain equivalent admin remains unresolved.
